rq.research_question: How are automation, AI, and digital technologies transforming marketing and sales practices, and what benefits, challenges, and limitations does this bring?
rq.core_relation: the adoption/integration of AI and automation technologies (ML, chatbots, programmatic advertising, IT-marketing collaboration) as drivers of change in marketing and sales functions (personalization, brand management, customer value, consumer wellbeing)
out_of_scope: consumer wellbeing psychology as standalone topic
financial performance metrics unrelated to marketing
rq.note: The seeds coherently cluster around AI/automation's impact on marketing and sales, though a few (consumer wellbeing, entrepreneurship, edge computing) sit at the periphery rather than the core.
